title: Classroom Scene 9 — End of the School Day
purpose: Support inference, classroom routines and multi-step listening in a familiar end-of-day classroom scene.

sentenceModels: The child is packing the backpack.
The child is waiting near the teacher.
The child is putting the book away.
The child is working at the desk.

adultSupport.focus: Use the scene for end-of-day routines and for following two-step directions.
expansionPrompts: What usually happens before children go home?
First point to the child packing the backpack, then point to the child putting the book away.

visualAudit: Reviewed in Wave 3 Batch 3 automatic pass against the main teaching targets.
